experimentalPeriod.scope: campaign start/end include excluded setup; measured timestamps are client wall-clock context, not latency clocks

methodology.sequencing: Sequential deployments; one distinct funded signer and nonce allocator per platform; concurrent operation workers with seeded balanced launch order; all workers settle before the next operation; stop at first failed comparison. Input preparation precedes each worker submission and is not synchronized across platforms.
methodology.pairing: same operation and round; nearby observations, not identical network conditions
methodology.tests: two-sided paired t-tests of round-matched mean differences; approximate inference assumes independent round differences
methodology.uncertainty: sample SD; pointwise paired-t 95% CIs are not simultaneous; circular paired-difference block bootstrap is a sensitivity analysis (length 3, 20000 resamples)
methodology.scope: observable deployment-level performance, not pure TFHE compute; serial correlation/heavy tails can limit paired-t inference
methodology.readyDecrypt: reported separately by operation; primary classic ready-decrypt comparison uses notarize only, not pooled across operations
methodology.clientLifecycle: input preparation plus transaction-to-validated-plaintext; geometric FHE/baseline ratios use round-matched log ratios and Holm correction over ten tests
